Services
Experience the ultimate in comfort and luxury at Hotel Deepa Comforts, where our warm hospitality and exceptional service guarantee a memorable stay. Savor a rich culinary journey with our signature restaurant, serving delectable local and international cuisine for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Unwind with an expertly crafted cocktail or fine wine at our stylish bar, where every moment is a delight. We offer the finest experiences, tailored to surpass your expectations.
Business
Seamless Support for Your Success
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers an oasis of serenity, providing impeccable service and meticulous attention to detail for business travelers. Strategically located in the heart of the city, the hotel provides easy access to business districts and key locations. It features modern amenities like Wi-Fi, a 24-hour business center, exclusive dining outlets, and a well-equipped health club. With round-the-clock service and a unique blend of Indian and Asian hospitality, Hotel Deepa Comforts ensures a memorable and comfortable stay for all guests.
Travel & Concierge
Unforgettable Journeys Begin Here
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a comprehensive travel desk service, providing guided city sightseeing, air ticket reconfirmation, airport pick-up and drop-off, and car rentals. The hotel also arranges reservations outside Mangalore and can provide multilingual guides upon request. With 24-hour service, the travel desk is dedicated to managing every aspect of your travel plans, ensuring a smooth and convenient experience. Mangalore, Karnataka's fastest-growing coastal city, serves as the political and business hub of the state, offering a unique blend of culture and modern development.
Beauty & Wellness
Indulge in inner & Outer Radiance
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a wide range of spa services, including pedicure/manicure (spa and regular), hair treatments (hairfall, spa dandruff, and damage), hair setting, henna application, anti-aging and face lifting treatments (including international options), and bridal makeovers. Additional services include threading, waxing (international and normal), body massage, body polish, and facials (acne treatments and pigmentation care). With a full suite of spa services, the hotel provides guests with a luxurious and rejuvenating experience.
Health & Fitness
Stay Active, Stay Empowered
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a well-equipped health club featuring treadmills, cardio machines, elliptical trainers, and yoga mats. The facilities are designed to support a wide range of fitness goals, including weight loss or gain. Guests can enjoy a balanced workout experience with access to modern equipment for their fitness needs, ensuring a healthy and active stay during their time at the hotel.
